en: Morning, Ryoma.
Ah... We're way past morning by this point.

Huh, really? Didn't the morning announcement
just play, though?

In prison, mornings were a lot earlier.
We started at dawn.
Th-That early?

In the day we'd do our work and eat at the 
same time. At night, all we could do was sleep.

Inside those prison walls...
I lived a frighteningly disciplined life.

Ummm...I suppose that sort of life
sounds...healthy, I guess?
Hmph... Healthy body, healthy mind?
That's a bitter irony...

<CLT=cltMIND>That's right... Ryoma was a famous tennis
player before he became a prisoner.
<CLT=cltMIND>Did I make him feel bad?
Yes
No
Are you unsure of something?
<CLT=cltSYSTEM>Would you like to leave?
